[{"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":10,"var":"data,size","code":"dumpDataToPcapFile(data, size, tmpFile.c_str())","note":"The raw fuzz input is persisted as a temporary capture file, so attacker bytes directly control the packet bytes later parsed by PcapPlusPlus."},{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"reader","code":"pcpp::IFileReaderDevice::getReader(tmpFile)","note":"The temporary file is reopened through the pcapng reader, which interprets the attacker-controlled bytes as capture blocks and packet payloads."},{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"rawPacket","code":"reader->getNextPackets(packets, 1)","note":"The first decoded packet becomes the raw packet object that feeds protocol parsing and layer construction."},{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Tests/Fuzzers/FuzzTarget.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":47,"var":"parsedPacket","code":"pcpp::Packet parsedPacket(&rawPacket)","note":"Packet parsing walks the attacker-controlled packet bytes and can instantiate a BGP UPDATE layer from the payload."},{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/BgpLayer.cpp","function":"BgpUpdateMessageLayer::setNetworkLayerReachabilityInfo","line":709,"var":"newNlriDataLen","code":"size_t newNlriDataLen = prefixAndIPDataToByteArray(nlri, newNlriData, 1500);","note":"The NLRI vector is serialized into a byte buffer; its computed length determines whether the layer must grow or shrink."},{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/BgpLayer.cpp","function":"BgpUpdateMessageLayer::setNetworkLayerReachabilityInfo","line":716,"var":"extendLayer(...)","code":"extendLayer(sizeof(bgp_common_header) + 2*sizeof(uint16_t) + curWithdrawnRoutesDataLen + curPathAttributesDataLen, newNlriDataLen - curNlriDataLen)","note":"When the new NLRI is larger than the current one, the code forwards the size delta into Packet::extendLayer at the NLRI offset."},{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/Packet.cpp","function":"Packet::extendLayer","line":573,"var":"numOfBytesToExtend","code":"m_RawPacket->insertData(indexToInsertData, nullptr, numOfBytesToExtend);","note":"Packet::extendLayer converts the request into a raw-packet insertion; if the computed delta is negative in the caller's arithmetic, it becomes a dangerous size argument here."},{"step":8,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/RawPacket.cpp","function":"RawPacket::insertData","line":137,"var":"dataToInsertLen","code":"memmove((uint8_t*)m_RawData + atIndex + dataToInsertLen, (uint8_t*)m_RawData + atIndex, m_RawDataLen - atIndex);","note":"The sink performs memmove using the requested insertion length, and ASAN reports negative-size-param when that length is interpreted as a huge unsigned value after conversion."}]
JSON
